snippet.title: Monday Night Combat PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Monday Night Combat launches on Steam with a crossover promotion with Valve's Team Fortress 2 and a homage to a Penny Arcade character.

Purchase Monday Night Combat on Steam by Feburary 1st to unlock items in TF2 and MNC

http://store.steampowered.com/app/63200/
